notes.title: Big spring upgrade!
notes.content:
I'm very proud to present what is probably the most important upgrade since the game's release! On the program: new game modes, revamped menus with multiple skins save, a seasonal theme and other surprises!

[previewyoutube=NtPT7LtxPYE;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]New game modes[/h3]

This is [u]THE[/u] major feature of this upgrade: the introduction of new game modes, to diversify the pleasures! In addition to the “classic” mode you've been familiar with since the game's release, you can now play as a team, where [u]fun[/u] points are accumulated, so you lose together, and win together... be careful not to slap your mates!

But above all, you'll find some of the great classics of playground games:
[list][*][b]British Bulldog:[/b] cross the playground without getting caught by the bulldogs, or you'll be bulldogged in the next round. But the more bulldogs there are, the less stamina they have! Which little brat will be bulldogged last?[/*][*][b]Chicken-Fox-Snake:[/b] three teams chase each other: the foxes catch the chickens, the chickens catch the snakes, the snakes catch the foxes. Catch your prey, flee from your predators, free your mates and make your team win![/*][*][b]Tag:[/b] if “it” catches you, you become [u]it[/u] in its place! There's no way to defend yourself other than by running... and to make things worse, [u]it[/u] has got a stamina bonus! Which little brats will manage to be “it” for the shortest time?[/*][*][b]Family Tag:[/b] if one of the “it”-players catches you, you also become [u]it[/u]! There's no way to defend yourself other than by running... Which little brats will be the last to become “it”?[/*][*][b]Freeze Tag:[/b] if “it” catches you, you'll freeze in place and you won't be able to move until you're freed! There's no way to defend yourself other than by running... and to make things worse, [u]it[/u] has got a stamina bonus! Will “it” manage to freeze everyone?[/*][/list]
Each of these modes is available in single-player, duo and multiplayer (LAN or Internet) versions. Other game modes will no doubt be added in future updates (did I hear “off-ground tag”?).

[h3]New achievements[/h3]

New game modes mean new achievements!

No fewer than 9 new achievements have been added to the existing 16, bringing the total to 25! Of course, some of these achievements can only be unlocked in certain game modes. Two of these successes are also “titles” that you can obtain in the scoreboard at the end of the game.

I leave it to you to discover them by testing these modes!

[h3]Multiple skins save[/h3]

To take account of the choice of game mode, the menu interface has been extensively redesigned: [u]skin[/u] editing is no longer the central part of the menu, but has been moved to an auxiliary menu.

On the other hand, you can now save complete [u]skins[/u] and select the one you want to use with a single click!  Handy if several people are playing on the same computer, or if you want to be able to find the same outfit without having to recreate it item by item.

[h3]A spring look, Easter decorations and new skins[/h3]

At this level, it's almost a detail, but just like the Halloween update and Christmas update, this new version brings you a spring look, complete with blossoming trees and butterflies!  Until the end of April, Easter decorations have also been added. And of course, a few new [u]skins[/u] elements complete the package (who said anything about a bunny hat?).

I wish you lots of [u]fun[/u] as you discover this major upgrade, and see you soon!

notes.title: Christmas upgrade!
notes.content:
After the Halloween upgrade, it was only logical to bring a Christmas upgrade! On the program? A seasonal theme, new game objectives and new skins!

[previewyoutube=0yPOvo6nWXk;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]A winter look[/h2]

Just as the previous update added an autumnal theme, here come winter flakes! For the duration of winter (in the northern hemisphere, as the game's school is in France), the playground will be covered in snow!

Until the end of the year, there will also be Christmas decorations: tree, baubles and other garlands...

[h2]Objective Lists[/h2]

Here's a little addition to spice up your games: a list of objectives to complete. Each little brat now has a list of 3 objectives that will bring bonus fun points at the end of the game if they're completed!

Each list is random, different and secret (except in 1 vs 1 split-screen mode, where, of course, you can see your sidekick's objectives), but several little brats can have a common objective, which can lead to conflict...

Will you manage to check off all 3 objectives to get an extra bonus?

[h2]New skin items[/h2]

In addition to the famous Santa hat, you'll now have access to a cat hat, an itchy wool sweater, a Christmas sweater with a magnificent reindeer (in the best possible taste), and a superb hoodie!

The perfect opportunity to customize your little brat even more... until the next upgrade and many other additions!

Stay tuned, enjoy the game, and Merry Christmas!

notes.title: Halloween upgrade!
notes.content:
It's Halloween in a few days, and for the occasion, the first upgrade for [u]Litte Brats![/u] is already available! On the program? A seasonal theme, a 1 vs 1 split-screen mode, and more!

[previewyoutube=crgCU4DTqzU;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]An autumnal look[/b]

Of course, the most visible feature is the introduction of seasonal scenery: for the duration of autumn (in the northern hemisphere, as the game's school is in France), playtime will take place in pastel-orange hues, with its deluge of dead leaves. Other seasonal themes will be added in future upgrades.

For a few days, Halloween decorations will also be available: skeletons, bats, cobwebs... A few new [u]skins[/u] elements have also been added to character creation. These elements will remain available afterwards, even if some are thematically linked to Halloween.

[b]1 vs 1 mode[/b]

This is a mode I'd planned to include from the very start, but which was absent from V1 due to lack of time... I've since been asked for it again, and it's now integrated into the game: the 1 vs 1 split-screen mode.

This means you can now play with two people behind the same computer, sharing the keyboard or using controllers (or a controller and keyboard, etc.).

[b]New items[/b]

Three new items have been added to the list of games your little brats can play:
[list][*][b]the seesaw[/b]: just like the merry-go-round, this is a game that earns you more points if you play it with someone else! So you'll have to put aside fighting with your comrades (at least temporarily).[/*][*][b]the bubble wand[/b]: for this one, I must confess to one thing... it's not [u]really[/u] a novelty. In fact, this object was in the game code from the start (it even appeared [url=https://aperi.tube/w/dzAra7cdCSTRONGBKN6U8BJQT6]in the trailer[/url]), but due to a  [u]bug[/u], it was never instantiated during gameplay! This has now been corrected, and you can now enjoy this pretty bubble wand...[/*][*][b]the cuddly toy[/b]: a rather special toy, as it will give you permanent fun points, even if you “don't use it”... and it won't prevent you from running, unlike the other items. On the other hand, the fun you get out of it is relatively low...[/*][/list][b]Other small additions[/b]
A few bugs have been fixed, and several improvements have been made: a game creation menu has been added to unclutter the home screen; using the joystick in menus has been facilitated by better displays of active buttons. The key change menu has also been fixed with the joystick (in V1, there were unwanted line breaks).

[b]Happy Halloween and enjoy the game![/b]

I hope you enjoy this first upgrade... see you in a few weeks for the next one, in which I'll certainly ask you what you'd like to see. As I've said many times before, “this is just the beginning!”

Happy Halloween and happy gaming!

notes.title: “Little Brats!” is released!
notes.content:
After a two-week delay, the game was finally released yesterday!  Thanks to all those who have already bought it. It's been a lot of work, and I'm very proud of this new release.

The work began just 8 months ago, and required some 400 hours of development, 70 hours of graphics, 38 hours of music, 13 hours of writing, as well as a few more hours for communication, administration, and so on.

A huge thank you to all those who took part in testing this clearly multiplayer-oriented game: Frédéric Reith, Antoine Lam, Lucas and Jolan, Jean-Pierre Pagat-Vergne, Monalisa Hannot, Jérémy Tardat, Booteille, Marien, Martin, Fla, Pouhiou and Squeeek.

[h2]Follow me![/h2]

I've created several accounts dedicated to communication around the game (my usual social media accounts being restricted to a French-speaking audience). I'll be posting gameplay videos, artworks, technical points, making-ofs and so on. You can now follow all this on the platform of your choice (in this order of preference):
[list][*][url=https://mstdn.games/@ptiloukstudios][b]Mastodon[/b][/url][/*][*][url=https://www.instagram.com/ptilouknetstudios/][b]Instagram[/b][/url][/*][*][url=https://x.com/PtiloukStudios][b]Twitter (well, X, lol)[/b][/url][/*][/list]

[h2]The future[/h2]

I've already said it, but I'll say it again: this release is just the beginning of the adventure. I've got a huge todo list of new content to add, new toys, new game modes, new scenery, new music, and so on.

There will be regular updates (and free/included, no paid DLC), at least throughout the coming year.

So stay tuned for new updates by following the social media listed above!

See you soon for new adventures!

notes.title: Release date postponed to October 1
notes.content:
It is with some sadness that I have to inform you that the release date of [i]Little Brats![/i] has been postponed by two weeks: [b]the game will therefore be released on October 1[/b] instead of September 18 as previously announced.

The reason is simple: the latest beta tests have brought to my attention a number of bugs that indicate a noticeable instability in the game's netcode (the part that manages network communication for multiplayer). I estimate that consolidating this netcode will require a significant amount of work, and I don't think it's wise to continue planning for the release in 2 weeks (!) with this uncertainty about the quality of multiplayer. Considering that there are also other things I'd like to add before the release...

Anyway, sorry for the delay. Of course, the main purpose of this delay is to offer you a great multiplayer experience, with the goal of producing a game of the highest possible quality. Better a good game late than a buggy game on time...

Thanks for your patience!

notes.title: “Little Brats!”, scheduled for September 18, 2024
notes.content:
This time it's official: [i]Little Brats![/i] will be released on September 18. Makes sense to release a playground simulator during the back-to-school month!

For the occasion, the official trailer has been unveiled!

[previewyoutube=oUluRvQJqxo;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]What is this game?[/h2]

If, graphically, my style already used in the [i]point and click[/i] [url=https://studios.ptilouk.net/superfluous-returnz]Superfluous Returnz[/url] is used once again, the type of game will be radically different: [i]Little Brats![/i] will be a fast-paced action game, mainly aimed at multiplayer (although it will also be playable solo).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44938785/66927f503beffd468d7d36020a7b195cb01e2bb0.jpg[/img]

You'll be controlling your brat through a school playground. Your goal? To have as much fun as possible. To do this, you'll have at your disposal both fixed games (swings, turnstiles, etc.) and portable toys (yo-yos, skipping ropes, etc.). The catch, of course, is that since there are only a few of these, you'll have to battle it out with the other brats... slapping while avoiding being slapped, keeping your toys as long as possible, stealing those of others while not getting caught by the teacher... playtime is gonna be no picnic.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44938785/f6a80fb93b0a0d3806d4fa49878ad18ac6629cf7.jpg[/img]

[h2]How do you play?[/h2]

The game will be available on [i]Windows/macOS/Linux[/i]. Ports to [i]Android[/i] and [i]Nintendo Switch[/i] are under consideration.

It can be played using a keyboard (optionally with a mouse) or a gamepad. Multiplayer will be online or in LAN. I may implement a split-screen version later.

The game is relatively [i]casual[/i], with a fast learning curve and a reduced number of buttons to use: direction buttons (or the stick on a controller), an action button, a secondary action button, and a [i]sprint[/i] button, and that's it.

Each game lasts a few minutes, just long enough for recess. At the end of the game, the bell will ring and you'll have to line up in pairs to return to class. You'll then be presented with a podium and a scoreboard, with titles awarded according to whether you've been particularly nice, nasty, etc.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44938785/d25a8e04c616ac885f283f9b51459b3742d3fec2.png[/img]

In addition to the people playing with you, the other brats will be directed by the computer, with randomly drawn names and skins: note that the names are those most given in 2018 (hence the Jackson, Isabelle, etc.). The game takes place in 2024, with children aged around 6...

[h2]Come as you are[/h2]

Particular attention has been paid to the customization of your brat: you can select their appearance, from their outfit to their hairstyle and their skin color.

There is deliberately no selection of the gender of your little brat: when drawing, I usually associate face shape 1 (the one with the big nose) with boys/men and shape 2 (round with a pointed nose) with girls/women, but you're free to choose the look that suits you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44938785/8fc66f495be646c6e234b75813787f6aa445d96b.jpg[/img]

Other variants will undoubtedly be added in future updates.

[h2]Collect cards[/h2]

A parody of [i]Pokémon[/i] is included: some fifty little creatures can be collected in the form of “cards”, which will be scattered by the [i]bots[/i] during gameplay. They will obviously be more or less rare, and will also bring you more or less fun.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44938785/7b21946e3009d01fd58e5b31b5eb9e16b5eef39a.jpg[/img]

For the time being, they're mainly designed as a humorous addition, and don't have their own use in the game, but I'm thinking about developing mechanics around them (exchanges, etc.). The difficulty will be to integrate them without breaking the fast pace of the game. Just wait and see.

I can't hide the fact that I can't wait for you to discover them, because I've included a lot of silly things that I'm proud of :D

[h2]An evolving game[/h2]

Unlike [i]Superfluous Returnz[/i], which was an adventure with a beginning and an end, [i]Little Brats![/i] will be enriched with content over the coming months. Please note that this will not be paid DLC, but updates [i]included[/i] with the purchase of the game.

As I said above, other skin variants will be added as updates come in, but not only: I'm also planning to add new fixed games, portable toys and a whole lot of other stuff.

I'm also thinking about adding other game modes (goal list game, team game, “protect the leader” game, etc.) and mini-games (small soccer field, etc.). We'll see, and I'll keep you posted –and certainly ask for your opinions– on what comes next.

[h2]See you soon[/h2]

See you in September for the game's release. Until then, I've got a busy schedule ahead of me to finish V1 of this game which, let me tell you, I'm already having a lot of fun with!

I hope you have a great summer, and I'll see you soon...
